definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of 就職活動. The process of seeking employment, especially for new graduates.

examples.japanese: {就活|しゅうかつ}を{始|はじ}める。
{就活|しゅうかつ}{中|ちゅう}の{学生|がくせい}。
examples.english: A student in the middle of job hunting.

examples.japanese: {就活|しゅうかつ}スーツを{買|か}う。
examples.notes: Standard dark suit worn for interviews

notes:
{就活|しゅうかつ} is an abbreviation of {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう} (job-seeking activities). It primarily refers to the structured job-hunting process for university students.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {就活|しゅうかつ}を{始|はじ}める: to start job hunting
- {就活|しゅうかつ}{中|ちゅう}: in the middle of job hunting
- {就活|しゅうかつ}スーツ: job-hunting suit (standard dark suit for interviews)
- {就活|しゅうかつ}サイト: job-hunting website
- {就活|しゅうかつ}セミナー: job-hunting seminar

CULTURE:
In Japan, {就活|しゅうかつ} follows a structured timeline: students typically begin in their third year of university, attending company information sessions ({説明会|せつめいかい}), submitting エントリーシート (application forms), and going through multiple interview rounds. The process is largely standardized across companies.

SIMILAR ～{活|かつ} ABBREVIATIONS:
- {婚活|こんかつ}: spouse hunting
- {終活|しゅうかつ}: end-of-life preparation (same pronunciation, different kanji)
- {朝活|あさかつ}: morning activities (productive use of early mornings)
